own_solution.law: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation: v = u ln(m0/mf)
assumptions: constant exhaust speed relative to the rocket (stated)

notes: Base: v = 3000 ln(3200/800) = 3000 ln 4 = 4158.88 m/s. With a 190 kg payload: v = 3000 ln(3390/990) = 3000*1.23088 = 3692.6 m/s. The burn rate enters m(t) and dv = -u dm/m but cancels in the absence of external forces (burn time 2400/27 = 88.9 s is irrelevant). Variant pairs: payload sentences all 190 kg where numeric; burn-rate sentences both 27 kg/s. T357D and T23F7 carry no number ('small payload'), so they are not numeric variants of their 190 kg counterparts.
